title: Isolated Claude E/P Study admission excluded the already observed native compaction contract

verified_by.scope: All nine retained complete native Turn traces are refused by v3 and accepted by v4, preserving modelUsage and complete started/completed/boundary observations. This is diagnostic replay, not reclassification of old Runs or device qualification.
verified_by.CPU_contracts: 66 provider/Study contracts passed in an owned fixed-commit worktree at 36e346b5

evidence.locator: Each retained Run's run_fault event and provider_stdout object, copied read-only to compaction-review/ under the same experiment root

observation: Nine completed Run records reached provider_fault at Turn 7 or 8 solely because the frozen v3 provider contract refuses context compaction. Their actual CLI result subtype is success and each raw stream contains a complete valid native compaction lifecycle. The existing v4 parser and replay already admit and charge these observations. E/P StudyPlan additionally required v3, preventing a new isolated Study from selecting v4 even when every condition shares the same policy.
proposed_change: Admit either frozen supported Claude event contract for isolated E/P Studies. A successor may select v4 for every cell, retain actual raw streams and native use accounting, and report per-Run compaction phases. Do not demand identical realized summaries or compaction counts across conditions, modify a frozen Run, relax incomplete-event rejection, or turn historical search timings into confirmation results.
principles: No IR, Compiler pass, Target, Workload, oracle or measurement change. Source commits and immutable Study assignments remain the execution boundary; Run owns native provider observations and Study owns treatment policy.
promotion_disposition: Promote the Study admission protocol repair and descriptive compaction projection. Old v3 Runs retain missing endpoints; all old candidates and measurements remain development evidence. No candidate promotion or claimed transfer gain.
